title: Alleged AI-Generated Deepfake of Western Australia Premier Roger Cook Used in YouTube Investment Scam

behaviors.text: Western Australia's Consumer Protection commissioner warned of a scam using a purported AI-generated deepfake of Premier a person to promote a fraudulent investment scheme in a YouTube pop-up ad.
The manipulated video reportedly uses less than 10 seconds of real footage and voice and falsely depicts Cook endorsing "low investment, high return" opportunities.
